sn17.6:1.2: adhigamāya → upari tatiyavagge tatiyacatutthasuttesu ‘‘mā ca kho tvaṃ tāta sekhaṃ… anupāpuṇātū’’ti āgataṃ. tena nayena idhāpi attho gahetabbo. ettha hi kiṃ saddena paṭikkhepatthopi sakkā ñātuṃ, yathā ‘‘sayaṃ abhiññāya kamuddiseyya’’nti. tasmā kaṃ… āgacchatūti ettha kamapi… mā āgacchatūti ca, kaṃ sekhaṃ… anupāpuṇātūti ettha kamapi sekhaṃ… mā pāpuṇātūti ca attho veditabbo. aṭṭhakathāṭīkāsu ca ayamevattho ñāpito
sn17.6:1.3: āgacchatu → upari tatiyavagge tariyacatutthasuttesu ‘‘mā ca kho tvaṃ tāta sekhaṃ… anupāpuṇātū’’ti āgataṃ. tena nayena idhāpi attho gahetabbo. ettha hi kiṃ saddena paṭikkhepatthopi sakkā ñātuṃ, yathā ‘‘sayaṃ abhiññāya kamuddiseyya’’nti. tasmā kaṃ… āgacchatūti ettha kamapi… mā āgacchatūtica, taṃ sekhaṃ… anupāpuṇātūti ettha kamapi sekhaṃ… mā pāpuṇātūti ca attho veditabbo. aṭṭhakathāṭīkāsu ca ayamevattho ñāpito | sekhaṃ → asanivicakkaṃ, taṃ sekhaṃ (pī. ka.), asanivicakkaṃ, sekhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.), asanivicakkaṃ āgacchatu, kaṃ sekhaṃ (?) | anupāpuṇātu → anupāpuṇāti (pī. ka.)
